form.label: Microsoft Cloud / M365 Event Hub SOC Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage view for broad Microsoft Cloud/M365 Event Hub or Cribl JSON relay. Covers declared synthetic-equivalent sourcetypes only; this is not replay/read-back or tenant validation.

search.query: (index=main OR index=netauth OR index=infraops OR index=netdlp OR index=epintel) (sourcetype="microsoft:365:management" OR sourcetype="microsoft:365:exchange:audit" OR sourcetype="microsoft:365:sharepoint:audit" OR sourcetype="microsoft:entra:audit" OR sourcetype="microsoft:entra:signin" OR sourcetype="microsoft:entra:identityprotection" OR sourcetype="microsoft:azure:resource" OR sourcetype="microsoft:azure:activity" OR sourcetype="microsoft:purview:dlp" OR sourcetype="microsoft:purview:audit" OR sourcetype="microsoft:defender:advancedhunting" OR sourcetype="microsoft:intune:audit") | eval ms_family=case(sourcetype="microsoft:365:management","M365 Management", sourcetype="microsoft:365:exchange:audit","Exchange Online", sourcetype="microsoft:365:sharepoint:audit","SharePoint/OneDrive routed", sourcetype="microsoft:entra:audit","Entra Audit", sourcetype="microsoft:entra:signin","Entra Sign-in", sourcetype="microsoft:entra:identityprotection","Entra Identity Protection", sourcetype="microsoft:azure:resource","Azure Resource", sourcetype="microsoft:azure:activity","Azure Activity", sourcetype="microsoft:purview:dlp","Purview DLP", sourcetype="microsoft:purview:audit","Purview Audit/Labels", sourcetype="microsoft:defender:advancedhunting","Defender Advanced Hunting", sourcetype="microsoft:intune:audit","Intune Audit", true(),sourcetype) | eval op_value=spath(_raw,"operationName.value"), status_value=spath(_raw,"status.value"), actor_upn=spath(_raw,"actor.userPrincipalName"), target_display=spath(_raw,"targetResources{0}.displayName"), entra_target_display=spath(_raw,"properties.targetResources{0}.displayName"), provider_value=spath(_raw,"resourceProviderName.value") | eval actor=coalesce(user, UserId, userPrincipalName, identity, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, caller, actor_upn), src_ip_norm=coalesce(src_ip, src, ClientIP, ipAddress, callerIpAddress), operation_norm=coalesce(operation, action, Operation, operationName, op_value, activity), result_norm=coalesce(result, result_code, result_description, ResultStatus, resultType, resultDescription, status_value, activityResult, riskState), object_norm=coalesce(object, ObjectId, resourceId, SiteUrl, DeviceName, SourceFileName, target_display, entra_target_display, SensitivityLabelName), app_norm=coalesce(app, Application, AppName, appDisplayName), marker_value=coalesce(marker, mvindex(spath(_raw,"marker"),0)), original_sourcetype=coalesce(ms_source_sourcetype, sourceType, sourcetype) | where like(coalesce(actor,""), "%$user_filter$%") OR "$user_filter$"="*" | where like(coalesce(operation_norm,""), "%$operation_filter$%") OR "$operation_filter$"="*"
| stats count
| search sourcetype IN ("microsoft:entra:audit","microsoft:entra:signin","microsoft:entra:identityprotection") | stats count
| search sourcetype IN ("microsoft:azure:resource","microsoft:azure:activity") | stats count
| search sourcetype IN ("microsoft:purview:dlp","microsoft:purview:audit") | stats count

panel.title: Event volume by Microsoft service family

search.query: | timechart span=15m count by ms_family limit=15 useother=f
| stats count by ms_family | sort - count

panel.title: Intake health by index, source, host, and sourcetype

search.query: | stats count dc(marker_value) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(original_sourcetype) as original_sourcetypes by index source host sourcetype ms_family | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count
| stats count dc(actor) as actors values(result_norm) as results by ms_family operation_norm | sort - count | head 25
| where isnotnull(actor) | stats count dc(operation_norm) as distinct_operations values(ms_family) as families values(src_ip_norm) as src_ips by actor | sort - count | head 25
| where isnotnull(src_ip_norm) | stats count dc(actor) as distinct_users dc(operation_norm) as distinct_operations values(ms_family) as families by src_ip_norm | sort - count | head 25

panel.title: Entra sign-in, Conditional Access, and risk

search.query: | search sourcetype="microsoft:entra:signin" | eval ca_status=coalesce(conditionalAccessStatus,"unknown"), signin_result=coalesce(result_norm,"unknown"), signin_risk=coalesce(risk_level, riskLevelAggregated,"unknown") | stats count by ca_status signin_result signin_risk appDisplayName actor src_ip_norm | sort - count

| search sourcetype IN ("microsoft:entra:audit","microsoft:entra:identityprotection") | eval risk=coalesce(risk_level,riskLevel,riskState,"n/a") | stats count values(result_norm) as results values(risk) as risk values(object_norm) as targets by ms_family operation_norm actor | sort - count | head 25
| search sourcetype="microsoft:365:exchange:audit" | stats count values(result_norm) as results values(object_norm) as objects by actor operation_norm | sort - count | head 25

| search sourcetype="microsoft:365:sharepoint:audit" | eval site=coalesce(SiteUrl, object_norm), file=coalesce(SourceFileName, ObjectId, object_norm) | stats count values(site) as sites values(file) as files by actor operation_norm | sort - count | head 25
| search sourcetype="microsoft:365:management" | stats count by Workload operation_norm actor result_norm | sort - count | head 25

| search sourcetype="microsoft:azure:resource" | rex field=resourceId "/providers/(?<azure_provider>[^/]+)/(?<azure_resource_type>[^/]+)/(?<azure_resource_name>[^/]+)" | stats count values(result_norm) as results values(src_ip_norm) as src_ips by azure_provider azure_resource_type azure_resource_name operation_norm actor | sort - count | head 25

| search sourcetype="microsoft:azure:activity" | rex field=resourceId "/providers/(?<azure_activity_provider>[^/]+)/(?<azure_activity_type>[^/]+)/(?<azure_activity_name>[^/]+)" | stats count values(status_value) as status values(src_ip_norm) as src_ips by operation_norm actor resourceGroupName azure_activity_provider azure_activity_type azure_activity_name correlationId | sort - count | head 25

| search sourcetype="microsoft:azure:resource" resourceId="*Microsoft.KeyVault*" | rex field=resourceId "/vaults/(?<keyvault_name>[^/]+)" | stats count values(result_norm) as results values(src_ip_norm) as src_ips by keyvault_name operation_norm actor | sort - count

| search sourcetype="microsoft:purview:dlp" | stats count values(result_norm) as results values(SensitiveInfoTypeData{}) as sensitive_info by PolicyName RuleName actor operation_norm | sort - count | head 25

| search sourcetype="microsoft:purview:audit" | stats count values(ResultStatus) as results values(SensitivityLabelName) as labels values(ObjectId) as objects by Workload operation_norm actor src_ip_norm | sort - count | head 25
| search sourcetype="microsoft:intune:audit" | stats count values(result_norm) as results values(target_display) as targets by operation_norm actor category | sort - count | head 25
| search sourcetype="microsoft:defender:advancedhunting" | stats count values(FileName) as files values(DeviceName) as devices by category operation_norm actor | sort - count | head 25
| search "SC4S_MICROSOFT_CLOUD_TEST_" | stats count values(index) as indexes values(sourcetype) as sourcetypes values(original_sourcetype) as original_sourcetypes by marker_value | sort marker_value

html.p: This dashboard covers current fixture-backed Microsoft Cloud/M365 sourcetypes: M365 management, Exchange, SharePoint/OneDrive-routed audit, Entra audit, Entra sign-in, Entra Identity Protection risky user shape, Azure resource, Azure Activity administrative shape, Purview DLP, Purview audit/sensitivity labels, Defender advanced hunting, and Intune audit/device compliance administration.

It still does not prove full Microsoft XDR, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, Sentinel, complete Intune operational inventory, complete Identity Protection detections, or full Conditional Access policy detail coverage. Add explicit sourcetypes, fixtures, extraction/read-back checks, and real Splunk indexed evidence before promoting those from gaps to validated SOC coverage.

search.query: | table _time index sourcetype source host ms_family actor src_ip_norm operation_norm result_norm object_norm app_norm marker_value _raw | sort - _time | head 50
